name: Stoveport
tagline: Operational infrastructure for the multi-brand delivery kitchen.
positioning: Stoveport unifies menu deployment, ticket routing, and unit economics across every virtual brand you run from a single physical kitchen.

hero.h1: Run every virtual brand from one control layer.
hero.sub: Stoveport consolidates menus, aggregator tickets, prep timing, and per-brand margin into a single operating console built for owner-operators managing multiple concepts out of one kitchen.

features.title: Unified ticket routing
features.description: Consolidate DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub orders into one expo screen with automatic prep-station assignment and firing sequence.

features.title: One-click menu deployment
features.description: Push price, hours, and 86'd items across every brand and marketplace at once. No more editing seven dashboards before the dinner rush.

features.title: Per-brand unit economics
features.description: See contribution margin by concept, daypart, and platform. Identify which virtual brand actually earns its shelf space.

features.title: Prep and labor scheduling
features.description: Forecast covers by hour, generate prep lists, and align staff seats to projected ticket volume across concurrent brands.

features.title: Compliance recordkeeping
features.description: Automated cook-temp logs, allergen manifests, and marketplace audit exports kept current for every jurisdiction you operate in.

features.title: Marketplace reconciliation
features.description: Match aggregator payouts to fired tickets and flag chargebacks, missing items, and commission discrepancies automatically.

testimonials.quote: Before Stoveport we edited five aggregator dashboards every morning. Now menu changes take one action and our expo screen stopped dropping tickets during peak. Order accuracy is up and comps are down.
testimonials.name: Marisol Rivera

testimonials.quote: The per-brand margin view told us one of our four concepts was losing money on every ticket. We cut it, reallocated the seats, and lifted total contribution the same week.
testimonials.name: Devin Osei

testimonials.quote: Reconciliation used to eat a full day each week. Stoveport flags the discrepancies and exports the audit trail. Our bookkeeper stopped asking me for screenshots.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadar

pricing.blurb: For a single kitchen running one to three virtual brands.
For growing operators scaling concepts across locations.
For franchise networks and kitchen aggregators.

homepage.footerBlurb: Stoveport is the operating console for multi-brand ghost kitchens. Deploy menus, route tickets, and measure margin from one place.
